title: Complete missing GET/:id and DELETE/:id in TypeScript Todo API
description: A TypeScript/Express todo API has GET /todos and POST /todos implemented and tested. The tests for GET /todos/:id and DELETE /todos/:id already exist and are failing. Implement both endpoints so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
The TypeScript/Express todo API in src/app.ts is missing two endpoints that the tests in tests/todos.test.ts already cover:
  - GET /todos/:id — return 200 + todo or 404
  - DELETE /todos/:id — return 204 or 404

Both operations already have implementations in src/store.ts. Wire them up in src/app.ts. Do not modify tests or store.ts. All 7 tests must pass.
success_criteria: DELETE /todos/:id route added, uses store logic
No modifications to tests or store.ts
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
